intent: Correlation middleware. Using MockServerWebExchange: when header X-Request-Id is present the same value is adopted; otherwise a non-blank UUID is generated; the value is echoed in the response header X-Request-Id and the chain is invoked exactly once with Reactor context key 'requestId' holding the value (assert from within a stub chain via Mono.deferContextual). Public constants HEADER='X-Request-Id' and CONTEXT_KEY='requestId'.

methods.signature: public Mono<Void> filter(ServerWebExchange exchange, WebFilterChain chain)
